summary.text: Penelope Tsernoglou is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 75 who has served since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A defense attorney by background, she chaired the House Elections Committee in the 2023-2024 session.

paragraphs.text: Tsernoglou was born in Detroit, earned an undergraduate degree in psychology and sociology from the University of Michigan, and received a law degree from Michigan State University.

Her career experience includes work as a defense attorney, and she has served on the East Lansing Human Relations Commission, the Capital Area Michigan Works! Board and the Ingham Drain Board of Determination.
Tsernoglou succeeded Democrat David LaGrand in District 75.
In the 2025-2026 session she serves on the House Oversight Committee.
She advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Frank Lambert in the general election on November 3, 2026.
